store.tagline: Blackjack on felt, arrows or mouse; the bankroll persists
features: A casino table in the panel: cards dealt in dealer order, the hole card flipping, chips for the bet
One-handed: arrows set the bet, `enter` deals, then `up` hit, `down` stand, `right` double, `left` split
Every move is a button with its key on it; the title says what happens next
Standard rules: dealer stands on 17, blackjack pays 3:2, double after split; H17 and insurance as settings
Leave with `escape` any time; the hand, the bankroll and the record are there when you come back
Signed in to pal, your chips and record follow you to every machine; the biggest bankroll and the longest winning streak go on leaderboards
